Unit 3 of a 4-PR stack continuing the config-resolution pipeline refactor (previous series: #30063–#30077, #30137). Based on #30229.

Retires kv_cache_dtype, dsa_prefill_backend and dsa_decode_backend. Every reader of the resolved values moves off server_args: the attention backends' init reads, the disaggregation handshake, configure_kv_cache_dtype itself, the kv-cache mixin, the DSA backend init and the DeepSeek forward methods read the flags tier; the TRT-LLM / tokenspeed MLA kv-dtype checks and the hisparse validation become view-reading passes at their legacy slots. The kv4 and prefill-only gates key on fp4_e2m1, which no declaration produces, so they correctly stay on the pristine input.

Getter ratchet 276 → 270.

Use runner-local dtype before loading KV scales

For a local/unpublished ModelRunner (the fallback case still supported by _record_kv_cache_dtype() below), this pre-configure gate now reads the process-global flags instead of the runner's own server_args. If that runner was created with kv_cache_dtype='fp8_e4m3' and a quantization_param_path while the published flags are still auto or belong to another runner, the scale file is skipped and the FP8 KV cache silently falls back to unit scales. Fresh evidence beyond the earlier configure finding is that this separate scale-loading check still uses get_flags() before the local fallback can run.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Use runner-local DSA backend settings

When a DSA backend is constructed for a local/mock runner whose server_args was not published into RuntimeContext (for example tests that instantiate DeepseekSparseAttnBackend directly), these reads see the process-global defaults or another runner's values instead of the runner's configured dsa_prefill_backend/dsa_decode_backend. In that scenario the cached impls can become None, and the decode path later reaches Unsupported self.dsa_decode_impl = None instead of using the backend specified on the runner; this should follow the runner-local resolved view/fallback rather than unconditional globals.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Preserve target KV dtype when draft runners resolve auto

With speculative decoding, the draft worker is initialized with the same published server_args object after the target runner has already recorded any load-time KV dtype into RuntimeContext flags. Because kv_cache_dtype is now retired from dual-apply, that runtime override no longer mutates server_args, and this resolved_view(self.server_args) read only sees the pristine/stashed value (often auto), not the published flag leaf. A draft model whose quant_config.kv_cache_quant_algo is FP8 can therefore enter the auto branch and _record_kv_cache_dtype() overwrites the process-global target flags with the draft dtype before memory pools/backends are initialized, causing target-side readers of get_flags().kv_cache_dtype to use the wrong dtype.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
